title: Virtual Screening and Molecular Docking to Study the Mechanism of Chinese Medicines in the Treatment of Coronavirus Infection.
authors: Ping, Fan; Wang, Yanxia; Shen, Xia; Tan, Conge; Zhu, Lin; Xing, Wenwen; Xu, Jun
journal: Medical science monitor : international medical journal of experimental and clinical research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药治疗冠状病毒感染的机制，核心是药物-靶点网络与分子对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND Heat-clearing and detoxifying herbs (HDHs) play an important role in the prevention and treatment of coronavirus infection. However, their mechanism of action needs further study. This study aimed to explore the anti-coronavirus basis and mechanism of HDHs. MATERIAL AND METHODS Database mining was performed on 7 HDHs. Core ingredients and targets were screened according to ADME rules combined with Neighborhood, Co-occurrence, Co-expression, and other algorithms. GO enrichment and KEGG pathway analyses were performed using the R language. Finally, high-throughput molecular docking was used for verification. RESULTS HDHs mainly acts on NOS3, EGFR, IL-6, MAPK8, PTGS2, MAPK14, NFKB1, and CASP3 through quercetin, luteolin, wogonin, indirubin alkaloids, ss-sitosterol, and isolariciresinol. These targets are mainly involved in the regulation of biological processes such as inflammation, activation of MAPK activity, and positive regulation of NF-kappaB transcription factor activity. Pathway analysis further revealed that the pathways regulated by these targets mainly include: signaling pathways related to viral and bacterial infections such as tuberculosis, influenza A, Ras signaling pathways; inflammation-related pathways such as the TLR, TNF, MAPK, and HIF-1 signaling pathways; and immune-related pathways such as NOD receptor signaling pathways. These pathways play a synergistic role in inhibiting lung inflammation and regulating immunity and antiviral activity. CONCLUSIONS HDHs play a role in the treatment of coronavirus infection by regulating the body's immunity, fighting inflammation, and antiviral activities, suggesting a molecular basis and new strategies for the treatment of COVID-19 and a foundation for the screening of new antiviral drugs.
abstract_zh: 背景 清热类解毒草药（HDHs）在冠状病毒感染的预防和治疗中发挥重要作用。然而，其作用机制需进一步研究。本研究旨在探讨HDHs的抗冠状病毒基础及其机制。材料与方法 对7种HDHs进行数据库挖掘。根据ADME规则，结合Neighborhood、Co-occurrence、Co-expression等算法筛选核心成分和靶点。使用R语言进行GO富集和KEGG通路分析。最后，采用高通量分子对接进行验证。结果 HDHs主要通过槲皮素、木犀草素、汉黄芩素、靛玉红生物碱、β-谷甾醇和异落叶松脂素作用于NOS3、EGFR、IL-6、MAPK8、PTGS2、MAPK14、NFKB1和CASP3。这些靶点主要涉及炎症、MAPK活性激活及NF-kappaB转录因子活性正向调节等生物过程的调控。通路分析进一步揭示，这些靶点调控的通路主要包括：与病毒和细菌感染相关的信号通路，如结核病、甲型流感、Ras信号通路；炎症相关通路，如TLR、TNF、MAPK和HIF-1信号通路；以及免疫相关通路，如NOD受体信号通路。这些通路在抑制肺部炎症、调节免疫和抗病毒活性方面发挥协同作用。结论 HDHs通过调节机体免疫、抗炎和抗病毒活性在治疗冠状病毒感染中发挥作用，为COVID-19的治疗提供了分子基础和新策略，并为新抗病毒药物的筛选奠定了基础。
